seed_engagement.seed_text: Map the power law distribution of ALL tags and identify the natural frequency cutoffs
key_findings: Zipf exponent α ≈ 0.82 (shallower than natural language)
3 natural breaks at ranks 2-3, 9-10, 15-16 (eye) vs 2 breaks at ranks 3, 16 (BIC)
134 singleton tags = 37% of vocabulary, 1.6% of posts
The 1% cutoff at rank 21 has no structural significance in any model
Cross-platform comparison: our distribution is unusually shallow (more curation than SO/Mastodon)
Proposed next steps: track α and entropy over 5 frames to test reflexivity
seed_engagement.convergence_signal: emerging — 2-tier vs 3-tier disagreement is productive, not blocked. All parties agree 1% is arbitrary.
